section.content: 本发明公开了一种高安全型无机隔膜复合电极制备方法及其制得的复合电极，制备方法包括以下步骤：(1)、制备负极电极极片；(2)、按质量份数称取去离子水、水性粘结剂、无机陶瓷粉和表面活性剂，将水性粘结剂加入部分去离子水中搅拌形成第一胶液，无机陶瓷粉、表面活性剂加入剩余去离子水中混合，再加入第一胶液搅拌分散，得到无机隔膜浆料；(3)、将步骤(2)所得无机隔膜浆料涂覆于步骤(1)制得的负极电极极片上烘干形成复合电极极片。本发明制得的复合电极极片组装成电池后具有良好的柔韧性，同时无机隔膜具有传统有机隔膜不具备的耐高温特性以及耐针刺特性。

The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode and the composite electrode prepared by the same, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a negative electrode pole piece; (2) weighing deionized water, a water-based binder, inorganic ceramic powder and a surfactant according to parts by weight, adding the water-based binder into part of the deionized water, stirring to form a first glue solution, adding the inorganic ceramic powder and the surfactant into the rest of the deionized water, mixing, adding the first glue solution, stirring and dispersing to obtain inorganic diaphragm slurry; (3) and (3) coating the inorganic diaphragm slurry obtained in the step (2) on the negative electrode pole piece prepared in the step (1) and drying to form a composite electrode pole piece. The composite electrode plate prepared by the invention has good flexibility after being assembled into a battery, and meanwhile, the inorganic diaphragm has the high temperature resistance and the anti-needling property which are not possessed by the traditional organic diaphragm.

Preparation method of high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode and composite electrode prepared by sameTechnical Field

The invention relates to a lithium ion battery, in particular to a preparation method of a high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode and a composite electrode prepared by the same.

Background

Although the diaphragm is one of four main materials of the lithium ion battery, the diaphragm does not participate in the internal electrochemical reaction, but as an important composition of the lithium ion battery, the diaphragm directly affects the key performances of the battery, such as the capacity, the cycle performance, the safety performance and the like, and particularly, with the continuous improvement of the specific energy density of the lithium ion battery, the requirement on the safety performance of the lithium ion battery is higher and higher, and the improvement of the diaphragm performance becomes a key direction for improving the safety performance of the lithium ion battery.

At present, the traditional marketable separator is mainly composed of polypropylene (PP), Polyethylene (PE) or a composite of the two. The diaphragm has high strength and chemical stability, has a contraction closing function at a certain temperature, improves impedance, and can prevent thermal runaway caused by temperature rise to a certain extent. However, the melting point of the organic diaphragm is about 170 ℃, and when the temperature continues to rise, the organic diaphragm can be melted and deformed, so that the positive and negative pole pieces are in direct contact, the short circuit area is enlarged, and further thermal runaway is caused. At present, the surface of a traditional organic diaphragm is coated with a 2-4 mu m inorganic ceramic coating to improve the safety performance of the diaphragm, but the safety performance of the battery such as needling is still difficult to be fundamentally improved. Compared with the traditional organic diaphragm and ceramic/organic composite diaphragm, the inorganic diaphragm has the characteristics of high thermal stability, good liquid absorption and the like, can bear high-temperature baking at 400 ℃ without deformation, and has incomparable advantages in the aspect of safety. The inorganic diaphragm is characterized by brittleness and frangibility, and is difficult to adapt to the existing lithium ion battery winding equipment, so that the inorganic diaphragm does not have industrialization conditions.

Therefore, there is a need for developing a method for preparing an inorganic separator composite electrode, which has simple steps and convenient operation, and is beneficial to maintaining good thermal stability during winding and short circuit.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to solve the defects of the background technology and provide a preparation method of an inorganic diaphragm composite electrode, which has simple steps and convenient operation and can still keep good thermal stability during short circuit.

The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: a preparation method of a high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode is characterized by comprising the following steps of,

(1) preparing the negative electrode pole piece

Coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil with the thickness of 8 mu m, and drying, drying and rolling to obtain a negative electrode pole piece with the thickness of 100-130 mu m;

(2) preparing the slurry of the electrodeless diaphragm

Weighing 300-800 parts of deionized water, 20-50 parts of water-based binder, 800-1200 parts of inorganic ceramic powder and 10-30 parts of surfactant according to parts by weight, adding the water-based binder into part of the deionized water, stirring to form first glue solution, adding the inorganic ceramic powder and the surfactant into the rest of the deionized water, mixing, adding the first glue solution, stirring and dispersing to obtain inorganic diaphragm slurry;

(3) preparing the composite electrode pole piece

Coating the inorganic diaphragm slurry obtained in the step (2) on the negative electrode plate prepared in the step (1), and drying the negative electrode plate at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 30-120 s, at the temperature of 58-65 ℃ for 30-120 s and at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 30-120 s in sequence to form an inorganic diaphragm coating with the thickness of 20-50 mu m and the porosity of 40-60% on the negative electrode plate, wherein the negative electrode plate and the inorganic diaphragm coating jointly form a composite electrode plate.

Preferably, the inorganic ceramic powder in the step (2) is alpha-Al2O3、SiO2、TiO2、ZrO2One or more combinations thereof; the surfactant is one or more selected from carboxymethyl cellulose, polyethylene glycol, and n-propanol.

Preferably, the aqueous binder in step (2) is one of polyvinyl alcohol, polyethylene oxide, polyacrylonitrile, polyacrylate emulsion and styrene-butadiene emulsion.

Preferably, when the aqueous binder in the step (2) is one of polyvinyl alcohol, polyethylene oxide and polyacrylonitrile, the aqueous binder is added into part of deionized water, heated to 85-95 ℃, and stirred to form a first glue solution.

Preferably, the aqueous binder in the step (2) is added into part of deionized water and stirred for 2-3 hours at a stirring speed of 500-1000 rpm to form a first glue solution, the inorganic ceramic powder and the surfactant are added into the rest of deionized water and mixed, and then the first glue solution is added and stirred for 2-4 hours at a stirring speed of 10-30 rpm and a dispersion speed of 500-1000 rpm to obtain the inorganic diaphragm slurry.

Preferably, the preparation method of the negative electrode slurry in the step (1) comprises the following steps:

weighing 3000-4000 parts of N-methyl pyrrolidone, 3000-4500 parts of graphite, 30-80 parts of conductive agent, 120-200 parts of second binder and 1-2 parts of anhydrous oxalic acid according to parts by mass, adding the second binder into the N-methyl pyrrolidone, stirring and dispersing to obtain second glue solution, then sequentially adding the anhydrous oxalic acid, the conductive agent and half of the graphite, stirring and dispersing, and finally adding the rest of the graphite, stirring and dispersing to obtain negative electrode slurry.

Further, in the step (1), the conductive agent is one or a combination of more of super conductive carbon black, conductive graphite, conductive carbon fiber, carbon nano tube and graphene, and the second binder is one or a combination of more of polyvinylidene fluoride, polytetrafluoroethylene, polyamide and polyimide.

Further, when stirring and dispersing in the step (1), the stirring speed is 20-50 rpm, the dispersing speed is 1500-4000 rpm, the second binder is firstly added into the N-methyl pyrrolidone to be stirred and dispersed for 60min to obtain a second glue solution, then the anhydrous oxalic acid, the conductive agent and half of the graphite are sequentially added to be stirred and dispersed for 10min, and finally the rest of the graphite is added to be stirred and dispersed for 160 min.

Preferably, the coating speed of the cathode slurry in the step (1) is 2-8 m/min, and the coating speed of the electrodeless diaphragm slurry in the step (3) is 1-5 m/min.

The invention also provides a composite electrode prepared by any one of the preparation methods of the high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode.

The polyacrylate emulsion is a commercial product with the solid content of 39-41%, and the butylbenzene emulsion is a commercial product with the solid content of 49.0-51.0%. The particle size of the inorganic ceramic powder is D50-1-10 μm. Polyvinyl alcohol, polyethylene oxide and polyacrylonitrile are all powdery materials. According to the invention, the cathode slurry in the step (1) and the electrodeless diaphragm slurry in the step (2) are both completed in a separate planetary vacuum stirrer, and a stirring paddle and a dispersing paddle are arranged in the planetary vacuum stirrer and can be independently controlled.

The invention has the beneficial effects that:

1. the inorganic diaphragm composite electrode is obtained by preparing the electrodeless diaphragm slurry and coating the electrodeless diaphragm slurry on the negative electrode plate, and the preparation process is simple and is beneficial to production.

2. The composite pole piece has good flexibility after being assembled into a battery, and meanwhile, the inorganic diaphragm has high temperature resistance and needling resistance which are not possessed by the traditional organic diaphragm.

Detailed Description

The following specific examples further illustrate the invention in detail.

Example 1

The invention provides a preparation method of a high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode, which comprises the following steps,

(1) preparing the negative electrode pole piece

Weighing 3000 parts of N-methyl pyrrolidone (NMP for short), 3000 parts of graphite, 30 parts of a conductive agent (super conductive carbon black), 120 parts of a second binder (polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF)) and 1 part of anhydrous oxalic acid according to the mass parts, adding the second binder into the NMP, stirring at a stirring speed of 30rpm and a dispersion speed of 2500rpm for 1h to obtain a second glue solution, sequentially adding the anhydrous oxalic acid, the conductive agent and half of the mass of graphite, stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm for 10min, adding the rest of graphite, continuously stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm for 10min, and finally stirring at a stirring speed of 40rpm and a dispersion speed of 3500rpm for 150min to obtain a negative electrode slurry;

coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil with the thickness of 8 mu m at the coating speed of 2m/min, and drying, drying and rolling to obtain a negative electrode pole piece with the thickness of 100-130 mu m;

(2) preparing inorganic diaphragm slurry

Weighing 300 parts of deionized water, 20 parts of water-based binder (polyvinyl alcohol powder) and inorganic ceramic powder (SiO) according to parts by weight2)800 parts and 15 parts of a surfactant (carboxymethyl cellulose powder), and mixing an aqueous binder (poly (meth) acrylate)Vinyl alcohol powder) is added into partial deionized water (1/4-1/3 of deionized water mass) and stirred for 3 hours at the stirring speed of 600rpm under the condition of heating to 95 ℃ to form a first glue solution, and inorganic ceramic powder (SiO)2) Adding a surfactant (carboxymethyl cellulose) into the rest deionized water, mixing, adding a first glue solution, and stirring for 180min at a stirring speed of 15rpm and a dispersion speed of 700rpm to obtain inorganic diaphragm slurry;

(3) preparing the composite electrode pole piece

Coating the inorganic diaphragm slurry obtained in the step (2) on the negative electrode plate prepared in the step (1) at a coating speed of 1.5m/min, and drying the inorganic diaphragm slurry at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 80s, at the temperature of 58-65 ℃ for 80s and at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 80s in sequence to form an inorganic diaphragm coating with the thickness of 20-50 microns and the porosity of 54.8% on the negative electrode plate, wherein the negative electrode plate and the inorganic diaphragm coating jointly form a composite electrode plate.

Example 2

The invention provides a preparation method of a high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode, which comprises the following steps,

(1) preparing the negative electrode pole piece

Weighing 3000 parts of NMP, 3300 parts of graphite, 45 parts of a conductive agent (super conductive carbon black), 140 parts of a second binder (polyvinylidene fluoride PVDF) and 1 part of anhydrous oxalic acid in parts by mass, adding the second binder into the NMP, stirring for 1h at a stirring speed of 30rpm and a dispersion speed of 2500rpm to obtain a second glue solution, sequentially adding the anhydrous oxalic acid, the conductive agent and half of the graphite, stirring for 10min at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm, adding the rest graphite, continuously stirring for 10min at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm, and finally stirring for 150min at a stirring speed of 40rpm and a dispersion speed of 3800rpm to obtain a negative electrode slurry;

coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil with the thickness of 8 mu m at the coating speed of 3.5m/min, and drying, drying and rolling to obtain a negative electrode pole piece with the thickness of 100-130 mu m;

(2) preparing inorganic diaphragm slurry

Weighing 400 parts of deionized water and 400 parts of water-based binder (polyethylene) according to parts by massAlcohol powder) 20 parts, inorganic ceramic powder (alpha-Al)2O3)1000 parts of surfactant (carboxymethyl cellulose powder) and 30 parts of water-based binder (polyvinyl alcohol powder) are added into partial deionized water (1/4-1/3 of deionized water mass), the mixture is heated to 90 ℃ and stirred for 3 hours at a stirring speed of 600rpm to form a first glue solution, and inorganic ceramic powder (alpha-Al powder)2O3) Adding the surfactant ((carboxymethyl cellulose) into the rest deionized water for mixing, and then adding the first glue solution to stir at a stirring speed of 15rpm and a dispersion speed of 700rpm for 180min to obtain inorganic diaphragm slurry;

(3) preparing the composite electrode pole piece

Coating the inorganic diaphragm slurry obtained in the step (2) on the negative electrode plate prepared in the step (1) at a coating speed of 1m/min, and drying the inorganic diaphragm slurry at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 120s, at the temperature of 58-65 ℃ for 120s and at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 120s in sequence to form an inorganic diaphragm coating with the thickness of 20-50 microns and the porosity of 51.2% on the negative electrode plate, wherein the negative electrode plate and the inorganic diaphragm coating jointly form a composite electrode plate.

Example 3

The invention provides a preparation method of a high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode, which comprises the following steps,

(1) preparing the negative electrode pole piece

Weighing 3500 parts of NMP, 3800 parts of graphite, 60 parts of a conductive agent (carbon nano tube), 150 parts of a second binder (polyvinylidene fluoride PVDF) and 2 parts of anhydrous oxalic acid according to mass parts, adding the second binder into the NMP, stirring at a stirring speed of 30rpm and a dispersion speed of 2500rpm for 1h to obtain a second glue solution, sequentially adding the anhydrous oxalic acid, the conductive agent and half of the mass of graphite, stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm for 10min, adding the rest of graphite, continuously stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm for 10min, and finally stirring at a stirring speed of 40rpm and a dispersion speed of 3500rpm for 150min to obtain a negative electrode slurry;

coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil with the thickness of 8 mu m at the coating speed of 6m/min, and drying, drying and rolling to obtain a negative electrode pole piece with the thickness of 100-130 mu m;

(2) preparing inorganic diaphragm slurry

Weighing 500 parts by mass of deionized water, 40 parts by mass of water-based binder (polyoxyethylene powder) and inorganic ceramic powder (ZrO)2)1200 parts of water-based binder (polyethylene oxide) and 20 parts of surfactant (polyethylene glycol powder), adding the water-based binder (polyethylene oxide) into part of deionized water (1/4-1/3 based on the mass of the deionized water), heating to 88 ℃, stirring at a stirring speed of 500rpm for 2 hours to form a first glue solution, and inorganic ceramic powder (ZrO 2)2) Adding a surfactant (polyethylene glycol powder) into the rest deionized water, mixing, adding the first glue solution, and stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 800rpm for 180min to obtain inorganic diaphragm slurry;

(3) preparing the composite electrode pole piece

Coating the inorganic diaphragm slurry obtained in the step (2) on the negative electrode plate prepared in the step (1) at a coating speed of 2m/min, and drying the inorganic diaphragm slurry at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 60s, at the temperature of 58-65 ℃ for 60s and at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 60s in sequence to form an inorganic diaphragm coating with the thickness of 20-50 microns and the porosity of 57.2% on the negative electrode plate, wherein the negative electrode plate and the inorganic diaphragm coating jointly form a composite electrode plate.

Example 4

The invention provides a preparation method of a high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode, which comprises the following steps,

(1) preparing the negative electrode pole piece

Weighing 3500 parts of NMP, 4100 parts of graphite, 80 parts of conductive agent (conductive carbon fiber), 180 parts of second binder (polyvinylidene fluoride PVDF) and 2 parts of anhydrous oxalic acid according to mass parts, adding the second binder into NMP, stirring for 1h at a stirring speed of 30rpm and a dispersion speed of 2500rpm to obtain a second glue solution, sequentially adding the anhydrous oxalic acid, the conductive agent and half of the mass of graphite, stirring for 10min at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm, adding the rest of graphite, continuously stirring for 10min at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm, and finally stirring for 150min at a stirring speed of 40rpm and a dispersion speed of 3800rpm to obtain negative electrode slurry;

coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil with the thickness of 8 mu m at the coating speed of 8m/min, and drying, drying and rolling to obtain a negative electrode pole piece with the thickness of 100-130 mu m;

(2) preparing inorganic diaphragm slurry

Weighing 600 parts of deionized water, 25 parts of aqueous binder (SBR), and inorganic ceramic powder (TiO) according to the mass parts2)1200 parts of a water-based binder (styrene butadiene styrene emulsion SBR) and 30 parts of a surfactant (liquid n-propanol), adding the water-based binder (styrene butadiene emulsion SBR) into part of deionized water (1/4-1/3 mass percent of deionized water) and stirring at a stirring speed of 500rpm for 2 hours at normal temperature to form a first glue solution and inorganic ceramic powder (TiO powder)2) Adding a surfactant (n-propanol solution) into the rest deionized water, mixing, adding the first glue solution, and stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 600rpm for 240min to obtain inorganic diaphragm slurry;

(3) preparing the composite electrode pole piece

Coating the inorganic diaphragm slurry obtained in the step (2) on the negative electrode plate prepared in the step (1) at a coating speed of 5m/min, and drying the inorganic diaphragm slurry at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 30s, at the temperature of 58-65 ℃ for 30s and at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 30s in sequence to form an inorganic diaphragm coating with the thickness of 20-50 microns and the porosity of 49.5% on the negative electrode plate, wherein the negative electrode plate and the inorganic diaphragm coating jointly form a composite electrode plate.

Example 5

The invention provides a preparation method of a high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode, which comprises the following steps,

(1) preparing the negative electrode pole piece

Weighing 3800 parts of NMP, 4300 parts of graphite, 70 parts of a conductive agent (35 parts of each of super conductive carbon black and carbon nano tubes), 180 parts of a second binder (polyvinylidene fluoride PVDF) and 2 parts of anhydrous oxalic acid in parts by mass, adding the second binder into NMP, stirring at a stirring speed of 30rpm and a dispersion speed of 2500rpm for 1h to obtain a second glue solution, sequentially adding the anhydrous oxalic acid, the conductive agent and half of the graphite, stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm for 10min, adding the rest of the graphite, continuously stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm for 10min, and finally stirring at a stirring speed of 40rpm and a dispersion speed of 3800rpm for 150min to obtain a negative electrode slurry;

coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil with the thickness of 8 mu m at the coating speed of 6m/min, and drying, drying and rolling to obtain a negative electrode pole piece with the thickness of 100-130 mu m;

(2) preparing inorganic diaphragm slurry

Weighing 800 parts of deionized water, 50 parts of water-based binder (polyvinyl alcohol powder) and inorganic ceramic powder (SiO) according to parts by weight2)1200 parts of water-based binder (polyvinyl alcohol powder) and 25 parts of surfactant (liquid n-propanol), adding the water-based binder (polyvinyl alcohol powder) into part of deionized water (1/4-1/3 based on the mass of the deionized water), heating to 95 ℃, stirring at the stirring speed of 700rpm for 2 hours to form a first glue solution, and inorganic ceramic powder (SiO)2) Adding a surfactant (n-propanol solution) into the rest deionized water, mixing, adding the first glue solution, and stirring at a stirring speed of 15rpm and a dispersion speed of 600rpm for 240min to obtain inorganic diaphragm slurry;

(3) preparing the composite electrode pole piece

Coating the inorganic diaphragm slurry obtained in the step (2) on the negative electrode plate prepared in the step (1) at a coating speed of 2.5m/min, and drying the inorganic diaphragm slurry at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 50s, at the temperature of 58-65 ℃ for 50s and at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 50s in sequence to form an inorganic diaphragm coating with the thickness of 20-50 microns and the porosity of 47.2% on the negative electrode plate, wherein the negative electrode plate and the inorganic diaphragm coating jointly form a composite electrode plate.

Example 6

The invention provides a preparation method of a high-safety inorganic diaphragm composite electrode, which comprises the following steps,

(1) preparing the negative electrode pole piece

Weighing 4000 parts of NMP (N-methyl pyrrolidone), 4500 parts of graphite, 80 parts of a conductive agent (40 parts of each of super conductive carbon black and carbon nano tubes), 180 parts of a second binder (polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF)), and 2 parts of anhydrous oxalic acid according to mass parts, adding the second binder into the NMP, stirring at a stirring speed of 30rpm and a dispersion speed of 2500rpm for 1h to obtain a second glue solution, sequentially adding the anhydrous oxalic acid, the conductive agent and half of the mass of graphite, stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm for 10min, adding the rest of graphite, continuously stirring at a stirring speed of 20rpm and a dispersion speed of 1800rpm for 10min, and finally stirring at a stirring speed of 40rpm and a dispersion speed of 3800rpm for 150min to obtain a negative electrode slurry;

coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil with the thickness of 8 mu m at the coating speed of 6m/min, and drying, drying and rolling to obtain a negative electrode pole piece with the thickness of 100-130 mu m;

(2) preparing inorganic diaphragm slurry

Weighing 600 parts of deionized water, 30 parts of water-based binder (polyvinyl alcohol powder) and inorganic ceramic powder (SiO) according to parts by mass2)1200 parts of a water-based binder (polyvinyl alcohol powder) and 30 parts of a surfactant (carboxymethyl cellulose powder), adding the water-based binder (polyvinyl alcohol powder) into partial deionized water (1/4-1/3 based on the mass of the deionized water), heating to 95 ℃, stirring at a stirring speed of 700rpm for 2 hours to form a first glue solution, and adding inorganic ceramic powder (SiO)2) Adding a surfactant (carboxymethyl cellulose powder) into the rest deionized water, mixing, adding a first glue solution, and stirring at a stirring speed of 15rpm and a dispersion speed of 600rpm for 240min to obtain inorganic diaphragm slurry;

(3) preparing the composite electrode pole piece

Coating the inorganic diaphragm slurry obtained in the step (2) on the negative electrode plate prepared in the step (1) at a coating speed of 3m/min, and drying the inorganic diaphragm slurry at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 40s, at the temperature of 58-65 ℃ for 40s and at the temperature of 52-58 ℃ for 40s in sequence to form an inorganic diaphragm coating with the thickness of 20-50 microns and the porosity of 52.7% on the negative electrode plate, wherein the negative electrode plate and the inorganic diaphragm coating jointly form a composite electrode plate.

Performance testing

The composite electrode plates obtained in examples 1 to 6 were assembled into a battery, and a conventional organic separator and a negative electrode plate were assembled into a battery to obtain a comparative example 1, and a needling test was performed, wherein the result is shown in fig. 1 and table 1 below, and the needling method was performed by using a high temperature resistant steel needle having a diameter of 3mm as a single battery, the taper angle of the needle tip was 45 ° to 60 °, the surface of the needle was smooth, free of rust, oxide layer and oil stain, and the piercing was performed at a speed of (25 ± 5) mm/s. The puncture position is the middle of the rest four sides except the pole end face and the bottom face. Each time the needling is tested, a new steel needle should be replaced.

TABLE 1

As can be seen from table 1, the battery assembled by the composite electrode plate prepared by the present invention has good safety performance, and when internal short circuit is caused by puncture, the surface temperature of the battery cell still maintains a safe temperature range, and simultaneously maintains a certain voltage, whereas the battery cell using the conventional organic separator is difficult to avoid thermal runaway.

As can be seen from fig. 1 (the batteries assembled in examples 1 to 6 and comparative example 1 are arranged from left to right in fig. 1), the battery assembled by the composite electrode sheet prepared by the present invention still maintains a good state after being needled, and ignition and combustion of the battery are not caused, while the conventional battery has smoke generation and discharge phenomena after being needled, and the ignition phenomenon is more serious. The battery prepared by the composite electrode can ensure good safety in use, and can avoid thermal runaway caused by large-area short circuit even if the battery is subjected to needling, so that safety accidents are caused.
